title: Mandate
description: A Molt mandate: either the root mandate signed by the user's passkey ceremony when a tab is opened, or a purchase-scoped child mandate derived from it. Normative narrowing rule: a child MUST NOT exceed its parent on any bound (SPEC.md 4.2).

amountMinor.description: Money amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Floats are never used for money.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. A child mandate's currency MUST equal its parent's.

stepUpAction.description: Policy outcome for a step-up trigger: proceed silently, proceed and notify the user, hold until a Tap (passkey assertion) approves, or refuse.

stepUpPolicy.description: Per-trigger step-up policy set by the user at the ceremony.

unknown_merchant.description: Trigger: merchant not previously seen in this tab.

amount_above_baseline.description: Trigger: amount above a per-tx-max fraction or the rolling baseline.

mcc_outside_allowlist.description: Trigger: merchant category code outside the tab's allowlist.

bounds.description: Bounds shared by root and child mandates. The canonical JSON of this object is what gets hashed and signed.

amount_minor.description: Root: total budget of the tab. Child: the exact amount of this one purchase, which MUST NOT exceed the parent's remaining budget or per_tx_max_minor.

per_tx_max_minor.description: Per-transaction ceiling. For a child mandate this equals amount_minor.

expires_at.description: Expiry of this mandate. A child's expiry MUST NOT be later than its parent's; child default TTL is 15 minutes.

mcc_allowlist.description: Allowed ISO 18245 merchant category codes. A child's list MUST be a subset of its parent's.

merchant_denylist.description: Root only, optional: merchant origins the tab explicitly blocks.

velocity_per_hour.description: Maximum child mandates per rolling hour. A child's value MUST NOT exceed its parent's.

merchant_scope.description: Root: '*' or a pattern. Child: exactly one merchant origin (e.g. https://store.example.com) that matches the parent scope and is not denylisted.

rootMandate.description: The root mandate: one WebAuthn passkey ceremony signs these bounds; every purchase derives a child mandate from it.

kind.description: Discriminator: this is a root mandate.

tab_id.description: The tab this root mandate defines.

task_declaration.description: Free-text task the user delegated (e.g. 'Restock the office'). Signed as part of the ceremony; children reference it via their reason field.

webauthn_assertion.description: The WebAuthn assertion from the ceremony. Its challenge MUST be the SHA-256 of the canonical mandate JSON. Authenticates the user to the Tab Authority for mandate signing only; it is not SCA and no issuer may rely on it.

challenge_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the canonical bounds JSON the assertion signed. Verifiers recompute and compare to detect tampering.

childMandate.description: A purchase-scoped child mandate: one merchant, one cart hash, one amount, short TTL. In user-facing copy, a child mandate plus its payment instrument is a 'shell'.

kind.description: Discriminator: this is a child mandate.

tab_id.description: The tab this mandate belongs to.

parent_id.description: The parent mandate this child narrows. The narrowing rule binds every bound to this parent.

cart_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the normalized cart this mandate is scoped to. The preflight/commit protocol refuses commit on mismatch.

reason.description: Machine-readable link from this purchase to the root task_declaration (why the agent believes this purchase serves the delegated task).

status.description: Lifecycle: held mandates are unusable until a Tap approves; consumed means the single authorization happened (the shell was worn once and shed).
